findings.title: Re-enrollment no longer resets a REVOKED/RETIRED sensor
findings.impact: The prior release blocker (non-terminal revocation) is closed.

findings.title: HTTP transport hardening (rate limit, headers, slow-client guard) present
Inventory metrics collector no longer disables SSH host-key verification
evidence: comment records the previous unsafe behavior

findings.title: Raw host inventory file no longer world-readable on sensors
evidence: inventory file written with restrictive mode and read over mTLS

findings.title: Device mTLS private key is group-readable (0640), contradicting its documented 0600
evidence: src/falcon_agent/identity.py:8 docstring 'device.key.pem Ed25519 private key (0600, PKCS#8)'
src/falcon_agent/identity.py:70 and :79 same 0o640 on rotation / for the certificate
ledgers/contradiction_ledger.md:7 C-002 records the 0640 choice so Vector can read the key
findings.impact: Any process in group falcon-agent can read the sensor identity private key and impersonate the sensor (heartbeats, inventory, events, cert renewal) until revocation. The stated 0600 control is not in force.
findings.recommendation: Keep the identity private key 0600 and give Vector its own client certificate; widen only the certificate (0640), never the private key. Correct the docstring.
findings.note: re-audit 2026-10-04: AUTH-001 held (#40); key still 0640 at ba4becb

findings.title: Lab drill tooling disables SSH host-key and TLS verification
findings.impact: MITM/spoofing during device drills and skew checks; privileged remote commands run over an unverified channel. Lab-only.
findings.recommendation: Pin lab host keys via managed known_hosts and verify TLS with the lab CA, mirroring inventory_metrics.py.

report:
- Read-only analysis of `MaineCyberTech/falcon-edge` at `ba4becb` (git `ba4becb6ecd8fdc0c4e0363a67d7a62f60985788`, branch `main`).
- Deterministic lens (LLM-free) run on the lab (`ci-runner`, HTTP job API) and locally: LICENSE absent; no non-executable tracked `*.sh`; no CRLF tracked text; no tracked secret-like filenames; `.gitattributes` present.
- Wave-0 inventory via `tools/repo_inventory.py` (1,410 files; 5 workflows; 3 routes; 17 schema tables; 56 test files).
- Target repository is not applicable to this domain; the finding records the evidence and the future-readiness trigger.
- No secrets printed; all evidence is file:line references.
